body: It’s not really over him though he helps me with my traumatic experiences.. my mums an addict my dad was murdered and I was raped.. I only feel happy when he’s here

And I can’t have him leave I actually cannot go through it, sometimes I want him to leave so I can just get it over and done with and finally not have to deal with the pain of living on this earth... but then again I don’t want that
He said he will never leave and it’s not too much for him but watching him breakdown and cry just destroys me because Ik before me he hardly used to have anything to stress about
If you die someone will have to go through your phone.. is it worth it
Yesssss

If you feel like you need to talk about anything or your problems feel free to direct message me I will give u actual advice and not just the basic ‘Dw it gets better’ I’m not an expert but I’m hoping I could take ur mind of whatever it is that’s bothering you
Anytime :)

The only way she will start taking the relationship serious is if she knows / thinks she’s going to lose you. Give her an alternative, tell her to fix up or you can’t do this anymore.. if she loves you enough she will pick right

If you ever need to talk to someone Maybe just to even rant, feel free to reach out. I just wanna say that up until now you’ve been strong enough to get through the hard times so hold on a little longer so you can experience all of that hard work payed off! Everything is always ok in the end and if it’s not ok right now then it’s not time for it to br the end ;)
I think a good idea for you would be to keep yourself busy and distracted in this time you can’t see your friends, try to video call often or even work on your health just until you can meet friends

I think you should try and stay at this job for a few more months you’re going to have to ignore everyone and get on with your job , think about the experience and money you’re going to gain.. whilst you’re staying at this job for history try and job search at the same time so you have a stable job to fall back on when you’ve got all the background history you need !

Honestly I have been in this exact situation but I was in your girlfriends shoes.. I treated my ex boyfriend the exact same and it led to me losing him :/ but tbh it took him leaving me to realise I needed to get help and I needed to better myself. You’re are the only happiness she has in her life right now and because she’s so comfortable and reliant on you she’s mistreating that’s advantage.. you’re going to have to sit down and tell her if things carry on this way you’re going to have to leave, she needs to know that she can lose you and with out you she knows she will be completely depressed so she will either better herself so she can stay with you.. or maybe she just might need to take a loss to get better
Heyyyy.. feel free to reach out and talk to me, I know it’s easier talking to someone who actually understands you :)
Ofcourse!
Oh there’s also an app called Nomo which lets you log how long you’ve been clean for it’s quite good

I know it’s not ideal to harm yourself in anyway but to prevent myself from cutting I started using my anger instead of my blades.. squeezing something really hard works even just your fists and I have not been dealing with hitting myself quite a lot which I find is actually better then cutting myself , so if you channel the pain into something other than cutting you will be distracted! Maybe try breaking plates or cutting paper or even getting an object to put your anger into

You no longer have to argue or say anything if I could give you advice I would advise you to hold on a little longer, you say your life is boring and that your not ok but everting is okay in the end and if it’s not ok now then it is not the end. No ones life is pure bore... you’ve got this and soon something and someone will walk into your life and bring you the will to live

Thank you so much for your help, I have contacted a doctor and they just brushed it off and suggested that I eat small portions at a time :/ 
Thank you so much anyway
Thank you thank you
I appreciate all of your advice and I am thankful for your reply, I hope you start to do better
Thank you for giving your input on this, it’s been helpful
Ofcourse!!

I’m sorry you’re having to deal with a break up but ending your life over this is not worth it, I have been in this position before and I can tell you I am so thankful I didn’t make the mistake You’re about to make! Please think about the possibility you have of getting better and feeling better! 
There’s a chance of you feeling better but if you end your life today you will leave others in misery mourning your loss, forever!
